description: This repo is an UMBRELLA: its dependencies are the service charts we release ourselves. A bump here IS the deploy, so the base preset's weekly schedule, PR throttling and prCreation=status-success are wrong for it. status-success DEADLOCKS: an umbrella branch gets no presubmit until a PR exists, so no PR is ever created. prCreation=immediate opens the PR that then runs the gate.

packageRules.description: ONE PR for all of our own service charts, not one per chart. The base preset groups these by '{{{depName}}}', which on an UMBRELLA means N open PRs that each rewrite charts/*/Chart.lock -- and Chart.lock cannot be merged: its last line is a single digest covering every dependency, so any two bumps in flight collide at the same offset. Grouping keeps the preset rule's intent (immediate, self-approved, own charts only) and leaves exactly one lock writer.
